Honest env ref-lift found (split-init accumulation swaps the seat with no FAKE) and the bit-arm shift seat solved; the env-livelen route is measured dead.

Bit-arm seats reduced to an exact local-alloc model: the target's chain must be a per-arm LOCAL quantity, the 3-quantity hand-rolled sort cannot emit the needed order from the measured birth order, an

Named the bit-arm order divergence: sched1's birthing_insn_p boost (reg_n_sets==1 on a block-local `shift`); a function-scope shift/mask kills it and turns the whole bit-arm residual into pure registe

frontier.hypothesis: A BLOCK-LOCAL `shift` pseudo with reg_n_sets != 1 closes both bit arms outright: the emission order becomes addiu, li, lbu (arm A) and addiu, li, sllv, lbu (arm B), local-alloc's birth order becomes shift, mask, chain, and the three-quantity hand-rolled sort then hands out exactly shift $v0, mask $v1, chain $a0 in arm A and chain $v0 in arm B (the chain is born after the shift dies there, so it reuses $v0).
frontier.mechanism: birthing_insn_p (tools/gcc-2.7.2/sched.c:2504) gates on reg_n_sets[regno] == 1, and reg_n_sets is counted by flow BEFORE combine. Two sets in one basic block keep the pseudo local (local-alloc.c reg_basic_block) while making the boost impossible. The s3 unreachable-permutation kill was computed for the birth order mask, chain, shift, which only exists BECAUSE of the boost - with the boost gone the birth order is shift, mask, chain and the s3 sort analysis gives [0,1,2] = the target seats.
frontier.next_probe: Hunt for a two-set block-local shift that survives cse2. Foldable integer-constant splits are dead (s4). Untried: (a) a second set whose operand is not a compile-time constant in cse's view (the H6 env lever's shape - a symbol address or a memory read), (b) reusing an EXISTING local that is already set elsewhere in the function as the shift carrier (sanctioned variable-reuse family, .claude/rules/defeat-licm-hoist-var-reuse.md, FAKE required - check whether the borrowed pseudo stays block-local for local-alloc), (c) a `do { } while (0)` or duplicated-statement shape that gives the arm a second set. Verify each with a one-line grep of tmp/grind/func_80016E60/s4/sched.log for `ADJPRI insn=<addiu uid> ... birth=` after re-running tmp/grind/func_80016E60/s4/prio.sh.

frontier.hypothesis: Keeping the n4 shape (function-scope shift/mask, block-local bits) and moving the global.c seat of `shift` from $a0 to $v0 closes the bit arms from the other direction, because arm A's chain would then be pushed off $v0 onto $a0.
frontier.mechanism: local-alloc runs first and gives arm A's only block-local quantity (the chain) the lowest free hard reg, $v0; global.c then seats `shift` and `mask` around it. Forcing local-alloc to leave $v0 alone - e.g. by giving arm A a second block-local quantity born before the chain, or by lifting the chain onto the global path only in arm A - reverses the pair.
frontier.next_probe: On the n4 carrier, sweep: (i) arm A with mask block-local as well (two locals born before the chain), (ii) arm A's chain written as a direct read-modify-write on D_800A3788 (compiler temp) while arm B keeps the named `bits`, (iii) tools/ra_solver/local_extract.py QTYDBG plus tools/ra_solver/inverse_compose.py classify on the n4 state to get a typed REACHABLE/FORECLOSED verdict on `shift -> $v0` before spending more hand variants.

frontier.hypothesis: The env/select seat remains the larger residual (19 of the honest 30) and is unchanged by this session's work; the do-while(0) carrier is still the only measured lever that swaps it, at the cost of the `sw s5,44(sp) / move s5,a0` prologue pair.
frontier.mechanism: flow.c:2087 counts reg_n_refs before combine; global.c allocno_compare needs env at 8 weighted refs. The honest split-init env lever (s2 H6) measures 33 because combine parks one operand in env's own hard reg and the earlier birth deletes three reorg.c back-edge peels.
frontier.next_probe: Re-measure the carrier's prologue pair on the n4 chassis now that the bit arms carry no insn movement, and check whether that pair is a wrap artefact or an independent defect; then re-run the honest split-init env form on top of n4 to see whether the two levers compose (s2 measured them separately).
